content:
As the Best Buy 60th anniversary mega sale continues in full swing, this week's 25% discount on AirPods Pro 3 remains hot, AirPods Max 2 is $120 off across all five colors, and the historical low price on AirTag 2 is still available. However, today's 9to5Toys midday dispatch also has some newly arrived discounts for everyone to discover. If you're quick enough, the Apple official refurbished store has restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue all priced at $1,099; we also noticed a batch of brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pros with $400 off. The $100 discount on Apple Watch Series 11 has returned, with some models priced as low as just over $250, plus Twelve South accessory deals — Amazon's brand-new low-price Find My charger and Curve Nano MagSafe stand. See below for all the deals.

AirPods deals reach new lows, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, more models

After a whole summer of AirPods deal waves, almost all of the latest AirPods models have been further discounted. The highly sought-after AirPods Pro 3 is now at 25% off, offering one of the best prices ever, while AirPods 4 with ANC has dropped to its lowest price in months; AirPods Max 2 dropped an additional $120 earlier this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

AirTag 2 returns to historical low, starting at $22 (4-pack and single pack)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 "Premium" open-box $20 (new unit original price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (original price $99)

Best Buy launches 1-day anniversary LG sale: TVs from $330, $600 off 2026 OLED models, more deals

Back in stock: Apple refurbished store offers cheapest M5 MacBook Air at $1,099 (that's $200 off current new unit MSRP), while stocks last

Update (August 20): This deal has returned to stock, with Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue all priced at $1,099.

Folks, this deal probably won't last long — they never do. The Apple official refurbished store has restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue all shipping free at $1,099.

This specific configuration sells out fast every time Apple restocks it — if you're interested, don't hesitate — after all, it's the lowest entry price for an M5 MacBook Air.

The Apple official certified refurbished store is now selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air for $1,099 with free shipping, equipped with 16GB memory and 512GB storage. As mentioned above, Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue are available as of writing.

$1,299 original price for the model, that's $200 off the current new unit MSRP.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original new unit price $1,299)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

A reminder that all products at the Apple official refurbished store come with the following guarantees:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare purchase
  • Sold only after Apple's rigorous refurbishment process

For comparison, the same model new unit on Amazon is priced very close to the $1,299 MSRP, with the Silver configuration going as low as $1,240.

Amazon continues offering this batch of M5 Pro MacBook Pro deals, a hefty $400 off

As part of the 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy held a special 1-day Apple promotion event yesterday, with the main highlight being a massive $400 off two M5 Pro MacBook Pro models. If you missed it, Amazon is still offering these two deals today.

Amazon is still selling these two 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro models for $400 below MSRP — one is the base CPU/GPU specs, the other is the upgraded 18-core CPU/12-core configuration.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (original price $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (original price $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we recommended yesterday, which at the time looked likely to be 1-day only — Best Buy said it was 1-day, and at the time there was no way to know if Amazon would follow suit. Overall, Amazon could pull these deals at any time, but as of writing they're still valid, and we want to make sure everyone notices these bargains.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

B&H is now selling the Apple 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,699 with free shipping, equipped with 48GB memory and 1TB storage.

Originally priced at $3,099, that's $400 cheaper than buying directly from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary deal at $100 off, Best Buy open-box from $254

Although yesterday's 24-hour limited 60th anniversary Apple promotion event has ended, there are still plenty of bargains continuing to appear. Along with 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the return of the historical low on Apple's latest AirTag 2, we've also noticed significant $100 discounts on most of the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 models on Amazon and Best Buy — with "Premium" open-box versions, some models going as low as $254.

Amazon is once again selling all base 46mm Series 11 models for $329 with free shipping, that's $100 off the $429 MSRP, with discounts on all four case colors.

However, stock for the smaller and cheaper 42mm model is almost completely sold out. That's where Best Buy comes in.

Best Buy is running its week-long 60th anniversary sale, with all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models in stock and $100 off MSRP.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Although the price difference isn't huge, I do want to mention this Jet Black 42mm "Premium" open-box deal — $253.99 with free shipping, that's $145 off the new unit MSRP. Compared to buying a brand-new unit now which is only $45 cheaper, but $45 is no small sum, and it's the lowest price we can find at a reputable retailer.

Amazon's finest Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro now $220 off (matches Prime Day deals)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new unit price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original new unit price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new unit price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (original new unit price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (original new unit price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (original new unit price $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple refurbished store featured picks, you can get a fully capable iPhone 16 model from $699 with 1-year Apple warranty; the 1TB 16 Pro Max is $1,269 — that's $330 cheaper than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)

The Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the most beautiful MagSafe stands I've ever seen, grab it for $27 (original price $35)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Twelve South all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C charger now as low as $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for just $180? WD Elements portable hard drive drops to pre-price-hike low (today only)
  • Woot's latest sale gets Keychron mechanical keyboards from $20, up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime docking station is $100 off, hitting one of its lowest prices ever
  • This Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection, today $22
  • Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite kit upgrades your home theater experience with reactive lighting, from $110, other models from $60
  • Petcube Cam 360 monitors pets 360 degrees + two-way talk, from $35
  • Govee's latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite supports Matter, from $85, or other models from $80 with up to 47% off
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable, today $36

Amazon has $120 off AirPods Max 2 in all five colors (one of the best prices ever)

This week's major 60th anniversary sale is bringing one of the best prices ever for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with all five colors $120 off MSRP at Amazon.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Priced the same as the previous generation at $549, you save a solid $120 here, which is the lowest new unit price we can find at a reputable retailer right now.

Best Buy does have the Midnight black version at $403.99 with free shipping as a "Premium" open-box unit, though the price is lower, it may not be low enough to give up a brand-new unit.

Apple launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a shell change with a USB-C port added. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, its over-ear product line won't be updated in next month's new product launch, so the $120 discount we're seeing this week may be for Apple's most advanced over-ear headphone model.

Only one previous promotional event offered a lower price, which was Prime Day earlier this summer, that time it was $30 cheaper than the current price — but stock during the 4-day promotion was quite limited and unstable.

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger holds steady at $26, but this time the bundle adds a USB-C cable for just $4 more

As part of the ongoing 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy is selling the Anker 45W Nano smart display charger in white for $29.99 with free shipping, bundled with a Nano USB-C cable. Compared to the charger's special price of $25.99 with free shipping at Amazon and Best Buy, that's only about $4 more. Considering the Nano USB-C cable in the bundle typically sells for about $18 on its own, you're effectively paying just $4 to add a cable to go with the charger, which is a great deal. See below for details.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN smart display charger $25.99 (original price $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

The Anker 45W Nano charger features a built-in smart display that can identify supported devices like iPhone and iPad Pro models, and automatically adjust power delivery, making it a popular product. The screen also displays real-time charging information and animations, so you can see your device's charging status instantly. Equipped with a single top-mounted USB-C port with up to 45W output, plus foldable prongs that can rotate 180 degrees, it's convenient whether for daily use or travel. Anker offers four colors, including an orange version that matches perfectly with Apple's Cosmic Orange devices. This special price bundles the charger with an Anker Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. The braided cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it overall a solid choice, and if you need a new cable for charging, it's an even better value.

Other Anker deals worth noting

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (original price $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (original price $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (original price $150)
